notes.title: DiveReal Update #5 🤟 Chat, let's chat !
notes.content:
[h1]TADAAA ![/h1]

[b]Hi[/b] 👋 this is [b]Gab from DiveReal ![/b]

Today’s [I]the day[/I] : we just released a new update. And yes, we just released one of the most asked feature ; [b]text chat ![/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32918512/dc3fe219a91d1c8e0cd50450c2f6b3e33698b00e.jpg[/img]
[I]Yes, you know perfectly where I am standing right now.[/I]

Sometimes you connect, try to speak with someone but no luck; he has no mic. Talking is so much immersive, but sometimes you just don't have the choice ! [b]Let's get back to the keyboard and have a chat :)[/b]

We can now chat with others thanks to our newly added widget : [I]Discord[/I] ! 🔥

[b]Come on try it ride away! Here's a sneak peek ![/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32918512/c2ac9f929b72bc96c0628785587a2220ba9f5e74.gif[/img]
[I]Please stop this[/I]

That's it! Feel free to join our [url=https://discord.gg/nDBu7cP ]Discord[/url] or contact me per email (yesreply@divereal.com) to discuss about anything. 
You can also post on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/865200/discussions]Steam community hub[/url].

See you all soon 🤞

-Gab

notes.title: DiveReal Update #4 🤟 Explore the whole world! 🌎🌍🌏
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32918512/5277079b8d3dc4a3b90bf65b3d907a9d3d3dd39d.jpg[/img]

[b]It’s [i]L I V E[/i]  ![/b] You can now search and show your favorite places to other people. Explore places you never been before and locate yourself through your journey 🔥

Long time so see ! [b]We are back with new features[/b]. One of the most awaited one: search cool places on a map. Let’s explore Iceland, Moscow, or your cozy house in the countryside of Oregon. Every place covered by Street View is now accessible within clicks.

[b]So how do you access the whole world? Simply toggle tab[/b], enter the place you’d like to visit in the search box or move the map and teleport in a random place! 

[h1]Achievements are here too![/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32918512/efeb1cde324743bc0fb1fa4ee4bbe5eca576dc3a.png[/img]

4 new achievements have been added, and more to come.

That's all for today folks. Feel free to join our [url=https://discord.gg/nDBu7cP ]Discord[/url] or contact me per email (yesreply@divereal.com) to discuss about anything. 
You can also post on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/865200/discussions]Steam community hub[/url]

See you all soon 🤞


-Gab

notes.title: DiveReal Update #1 and Intergalactic General Assembly 🤟
notes.content:
[h1]Thank you![/h1]

What a week! Two weeks ago Joaquin and I released DiveReal on Steam and had the chance to welcome more than 1500 divers!
I met several people from around the planet, -including "soviet russia"- that were excited and teleported from Paris, New York, to Singapore and many other amazing places 🌍🌏🌎

[h1]Join us and our friends this [b]Sunday (07/01)[/b] for our first Intergalactic General Assembly![/h1]

[b]Europe[/b]: 3 pm GMT+1 (Paris)
[b]Asia[/b]: 9 pm GMT+8 (SG)
[b]Americas[/b]: 8 pm PST (SF)
[url=https://www.twitch.tv/divereal]Twitch livestream [/url]

[h1]Let’s get started - DiveReal Update[/h1]

Fired-up, ready to go! I’m eager to learn from YOU. We received a lot of feature requests in the first weeks of the release. I tried to torture our main dev to get them asap.

[b]Including:[/b]

[list]
[*]A [b]less bitcoin mining feeling[/b] (😆),[b] push to talk, a mute button[/b]. Done!
[*]I also added [b]new places[/b] featuring things you may have in Minecraft as well, such as lava, big rocks, Disneyland and a brand new beach in Singapore where our headquarters are located 🤟
[/list]
In the meantime, Oculus broke DiveReal in VR by releasing a buggy update of the Rift runtime. We hope it gets fixed soon.
 
That's it for today. Feel free to join me on our Discord to discuss about anything!
 
I'm looking forward to meet you all on Sunday 🤞

[b]-Gab[/b]

notes.title: DiveReal is live on Steam! 🚀
notes.content:
Welcome to DiveReal early access.

So yesss, we did it. DiveReal is on Steam and everyone can explore the real world with friends. But this is just the beginning, and you are our very first supporters throughout this journey! 
We hope that you help us shape the future of DiveReal, by giving feedback and criticising (yes!) the game, challenging us with new feature requests and find glitches. Because early access also means glitches, do not hesitate to submit any bug you might encounter during your exploration. 
We are a small team, eager to learn from you! 

For any bug, or feedback, or to say hello:

Feel free to send us an email at yesreply@divereal.com
And come discuss with us on [url=https://discord.gg/nDBu7cP]Discord[/url]
([i]The team is there 10h/7 GMT+8 :)[/i])
Send us your best in game findings! (Discord channel #must-see-places)

[b]What’s next?[/b]

Events, features and optimization.
Our journey is just starting as we plan to release new features and optimize the game in the coming months. Our challenge is to make you explore more and more places, but mostly to let you meet people and make new friends. 
We will keep you updated on our events schedule and roadmap in the coming days.

That's it!

See you next week and happy diving!
The DiveReal Team
